sources.title: OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet
sources.application: Bound receipt by declared type/signature, size, scoped authorization and integrity-checked attachment downloads. Signature checks do not certify safe or authentic content.

sources.title: IAASB 2025 Handbook, Volume 1
sources.application: Keep auditor control, response reliability, nonresponse/refusal, required-positive replies and all negative-only conditions distinct. Local adoption and actual professional judgment remain evidenced human decisions.

boundaries: No external message adapter, external-party identity verification, malware scan or whole-standard compliance certification is claimed.
The local response link is bounded engineering support; it does not substitute for professional confirmation evidence.
